_README: Hand-curated requiredSkill values for recipes whose data is missing
from every DBC dump and emulator SQL source we have access to.
Used as the TOP-PRIORITY source in build_authoritative_data.py — wins
over scroll RequiredSkillRank and trainer SQL ReqSkillRank when set.
Each entry: spell_id (string key) -> { reqSkill, source, verified_by }.
Populated per-profession during manual review of TBC-visible gaps.
'Apprentice X auto-grant' — recipe granted on training Apprentice tier
of profession X, no scroll/trainer service
'Wowhead'                  — value read from Wowhead's tooltip line
'in-game tooltip'          — value read from the user's own client
When adding entries, prefer the most authoritative source available;
include verified_by so future maintainers know whose call this was.
